captured_from: The Last Fleet: Runners, development build, commit e380706d

images.alt: Aerial view of ARI's home port: an oval concrete sea wall around a harbour, a dense town and container cranes along the inside, and a narrow mouth with a green and a red light, open sea all round.
From the water inside ARI's harbour at deck height: the long sea wall with flags and lookout posts, a tank farm, cranes and a lighthouse tower along the quay, and a small boat moored at the quay.
ARI's harbour mouth from the sea at deck height: the two ends of the sea wall with green and red navigation lights, flags and a name board on the wall, cranes behind.
Aerial view of the Fishing Federation anchorage: a walled harbour with brightly painted wooden houses along the quays, four long piers and a gate bridge between two towers, with an island beyond.
Close to a wooden pier on stilts: a crane, stacked cargo, barn-roofed red and green houses with orange roofs, and small figures on the pier.
The anchorage gate from the sea: a blue gate bridge between two towers with lighthouse lanterns and a fish figure on top, colourful houses along the wall.

federation.note: Drawn as a styled faction port (the RTS's fishing_federation layout), not as a small anchorage ring.

images.alt: Aerial view of Breakwater, The Commons: a rectangular wall of rusty, patched panels with a gap in the near side, enclosing three linked oil rig platforms and a small quay.
Deck-height view inside Breakwater: one of the rig platforms with lit windows and a derrick, a tug and a fuel boat at anchor, the patched wall behind.
Aerial view of The Last Resort: a round concrete ring wall with a gap, next to a green island, with two white cruise liners moored either side of a small pier with cranes.
Deck-height view between the two cruise liners, their cabin windows lit, looking at the small pier with cranes, a tug and other boats.
Aerial view of Midway: a wide ring of dark, ruined buildings and walls around a harbour with an island hub in the middle and gate towers, islands and distant ships beyond.
Inside Midway's harbour at deck height: dark gate towers joined by a bridge span, a ruined quayside and a small boat moored.
The toll-ring hub in the middle of Midway's harbour: a ring of dark towers with broken lattice spans, some hanging, and masts above, ruined walls behind.

midway.note: The game names it 'Midway (ruin)' and draws it ruined.

images.alt: Aerial view of Norfolk: a walled harbour with numbered wall sections, gate towers joined by a bridge, and long piers lined with hangars, islands beyond.
Deck-height view of a long pier lined with arched hangar sheds, containers, cranes and radio masts, with ships moored.
Norfolk's gate from the sea: two tiered grey towers marked 01 joined by a long bridge span, numbered wall sections either side.
Aerial view of Portsmouth: a rectangular stone wall with castle gate towers, red brick buildings and chimneys along the quays and a central pier, green-tinted sea.
Deck-height view of a quay of red brick warehouses, chimneys and a clock tower, with cranes and moored ships.
Portsmouth's gate from the sea: two stone towers with turrets and white banners with a red cross, joined by a covered bridge with an arch.
Aerial view of Severomorsk: a round sea wall lined with grey buildings and tower blocks, a tall tower in the middle of the town, and gantry gates.
Deck-height view inside: quayside sheds and a crane on the left, two ships moored, a gantry gate with blue saltire flags, and apartment blocks on the right.
Severomorsk's gate from the sea: a dark gantry with a red-and-white striped beam and two white flags with a blue saltire, walls, city and hills beyond.
Aerial view of Sanya: a star-shaped stone wall with red-roofed towers and large red gate arches, buildings along the quays, green islands beyond.
Deck-height view inside: a red gate arch hung with red lanterns, a lighthouse tower, quayside buildings with curved roofs and cranes, a grey ship moored on the right.
Sanya's gate from the sea: a tall dark red gate with a tiled roof and red lanterns, crenellated stone walls and a pagoda watchtower beside it.
Aerial view of Bandar Abbas: an oval stone wall with blue tiled details enclosing a long diagonal pier, on reddish-brown water with islands nearby.
Deck-height view across reddish-brown water to a long quay of white domed buildings, towers, tanks and moored ships.
The gate of Bandar Abbas from the sea: two tall towers with blue-tiled pointed arches joined by an arcaded bridge, walls with domes either side.
Aerial view of Yokosuka: a curved sea wall with a large red torii-style gate at the entrance, rows of buildings and quays inside, a coastline in the distance.
Deck-height view inside Yokosuka: a long quay with sheds, cranes and moored ships, a large grey ship with lit windows on the right.
Yokosuka's red torii-style gate over the harbour entrance seen from the sea, dark walls and white watch-houses either side, city towers inside.

dead_ports.note: The game builds all five of these ports (Yokosuka, Busan, Mumbai, Rio de Janeiro, Sydney) as intact, working navy ports in their nations' styles; none is drawn derelict yet. The stills show Yokosuka as the game draws it today.

images.alt: An oil rig with a derrick and lit decks inside a round concrete ring wall with four gaps, another rig and a coastline in the distance.
Deck-height view through a gap in the ring wall: the rig's deck on its legs with lit windows and a crane, a fishing boat moored beneath, red and green lights at the gap.
An oil rig with two tall arches over its derrick inside a round concrete ring wall with gaps and small watch posts.
Deck-height view through a gap in the ring wall: the rig's deck on its legs with lit windows and cyan lights, red and green lights either side of the gap.

pirate_rig.note: Gallows (27F), one of the two pirate holds in ARI's home waters. In the game today it is drawn exactly like any other rig: nothing on screen marks it as pirate-held except its floating name label (hidden in these stills).

destroyed_rig.reason: The game has no destroyed rig; the world plan only proposes a drawing (a broken ring with about half the arc standing).

images.alt: Aerial view of a Federation fishing ground: a small round concrete ring wall with gaps, inside it a small pier with a shed and crane, a factory trawler and several fishing boats, an island beyond.
Deck-height view inside the ring: a wooden pier hung with tyres, a fishing boat moored, a small launch, and the ring wall with lamp posts and a watch post.

fishing_ground.note: Federation fishing grounds 1, off Lima (32L); all eight grounds use the same small anchorage.

scrapper.name: Scrapper
scrapper.alt: The Scrapper, a small rusty workboat with a black hull, white boot-top, a dirty white wheelhouse and a yellow deck crane, on open sea.
scrapper.note: Starter hull; sold at ARI's yard.

mule.name: Mule
mule.alt: The Mule, a squat cream-painted cargo boat streaked with rust, with a high dark wheelhouse and a mast, on open sea.

dart.name: Dart
dart.alt: The Dart, a long low blue-and-white container runner with an orange gantry, rust streaks along the hull, on open sea.
dart.note: Sold at ARI's yard. The same model sails as the 'RUNNER' traffic boat.

barge_hound.name: Barge-Hound
barge_hound.alt: The Barge-Hound, a rust-streaked grey-green tug with a heavy black bow fender, red towing gear, a lifeboat and a tall mast with a lamp.
barge_hound.note: Built to order at ARI's yard for a Mule owner.

skipjack.name: Skipjack
skipjack.alt: The Skipjack, a grey-green patrol launch with a lit wheelhouse, a small gun turret forward and a radar mast.
skipjack.note: Built to order at ARI's yard for a Dart owner. The same model sails as the ARI patrol and escort.

workhorse.name: Workhorse
workhorse.alt: The Workhorse, a long green cargo hauler with an orange-red waterline, an open well deck and a wheelhouse aft, on open sea.
workhorse.note: In the game's catalogue, but no yard sells it yet (developer panel only).

gunrunner.name: Gunrunner
gunrunner.alt: The Gunrunner, a rust-streaked armed trawler hull with a lit wheelhouse, a red lifeboat, a deck gun and a tall mast with a lamp.
gunrunner.note: Built to order at ARI's yard for a Skipjack owner. Not on the world plan's list.

blockade_runner.name: Blockade Runner
blockade_runner.alt: The Blockade Runner, a long rust-streaked armoured gunboat with a gun turret forward, a lit wheelhouse and a red lifeboat.
blockade_runner.note: Built to order at ARI's yard.

freighter.name: Freighter
freighter.alt: The Freighter, a rusty black bulk carrier with four orange deck cranes and a white superstructure aft.
freighter.note: Built to order at ARI's yard.

corvette.name: Corvette
corvette.alt: The Corvette, a dark rust-streaked warship hull with a gun forward, rails along the deck and a tall mast.
corvette.note: In the game's catalogue, but no yard sells it yet (developer panel only).

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.alt: The Leviathan, a long rusty container ship with two orange deck cranes and a white superstructure aft.
leviathan.note: Built to order at ARI's yard.

frigate.name: Frigate
frigate.alt: A frigate, a rust-streaked dark warship with a red gun turret forward, lit bridge windows and a tall mast with a lamp.
frigate.note: A naval hull in the game's catalogue that only the developer panel puts a captain aboard; no navy ship sails as an NPC yet.

destroyer.name: Destroyer
destroyer.alt: A destroyer, a rust-streaked dark warship with a red gun turret forward, a tall lit bridge with a mast and lamp.
destroyer.note: Developer panel only; no navy ship sails as an NPC yet.

missile_cruiser.name: Missile Cruiser
missile_cruiser.alt: A missile cruiser, a long dark rust-streaked warship with launcher decks, a red gun turret forward and a bridge aft.
missile_cruiser.note: Developer panel only; no navy ship sails as an NPC yet.

battleship.name: Battleship
battleship.alt: A battleship, a long dark rust-streaked warship with red gun turrets, a funnel and a tall bridge.
battleship.note: Developer panel only; no navy ship sails as an NPC yet.

trader.name: TRADER
trader.alt: A grey bunker boat with large fuel tanks on deck, an orange crane arm and a lit wheelhouse, on open sea.

tug.name: TUG
tug.alt: A grey harbour tug with a black bow fender, orange towing gear, an orange lifeboat and a lit wheelhouse.
tug.note: Neutral traffic; also moored at Breakwater and The Last Resort.

fishing_boat.name: FISHING BOAT
fishing_boat.alt: A grey fishing boat with a lit wheelhouse, a net drum and an orange gantry with a hanging net, on open sea.
fishing_boat.note: Neutral traffic; also moored at the Federation ports and fishing grounds.

ari_patrol.name: ARI PATROL
ari_patrol.alt: An ARI patrol launch with a dark grey hull and orange stripe, a lit wheelhouse, a deck gun forward and a radar mast.
ari_patrol.note: ARI's patrol boats; the hired 'ARI ESCORT' uses the same model. The game has no separate 'ARI cutter'.

trawler.name: TRAWLER
trawler.alt: A converted trawler with a black hull, a red wheelhouse, an orange lifeboat, an orange gantry aft and a deck gun.

supply_ship.name: SUPPLY SHIP
supply_ship.alt: A blue offshore supply ship with a high white bridge forward, a long open deck aft with a small crane.

factory_trawler.name: FACTORY TRAWLER
factory_trawler.alt: A large blue factory trawler with a white superstructure and orange gantries and cranes aft.
factory_trawler.note: Neutral traffic; also moored at the Federation ports.

tanker.name: TANKER
tanker.alt: A long grey refitted tanker with pipework along the deck and a white superstructure aft.

pirate_skiff.name: PIRATE SKIFF
pirate_skiff.alt: A pirate skiff, a low dark raider boat with red trim, an open cabin frame and two antennas.

pirate_gunboat.name: PIRATE GUNBOAT
pirate_gunboat.alt: A pirate gunboat, a long dark hull with red trim, a boxy superstructure and a mast.

pirate_barrage.name: PIRATE BARRAGE BOAT
pirate_barrage.alt: A pirate barrage boat, a dark hull with red trim and rocket launcher racks on the after deck.

pirate_heavy.name: PIRATE HEAVY
pirate_heavy.alt: A pirate heavy, a rust-streaked dark sub-hunter with a red superstructure, red lifeboats and a gun turret forward.

pirate_flagship.name: PIRATE FLAGSHIP
pirate_flagship.alt: A pirate flagship, a long seized battleship painted dark red and black with big gun turrets and a funnel.
pirate_flagship.note: Appears at higher difficulty with three skiff escorts.

cruise_liner.name: Cruise liner
cruise_liner.alt: A white cruise liner with rows of lit cabin windows and orange lifeboats along her side, on open sea.
cruise_liner.note: Moored at The Last Resort; it never sails. No in-game name label (name from the game's ship data).

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.reason: Not in the main game; it exists only in the rejected Lite experiment kept for reference.

shade.name: Shade
shade.reason: Not built: the world plan's black-market stealth hull has no model or catalogue entry.

polynya.name: Polynya
polynya.reason: Not built: the world plan's ice-strengthened hull is a working name only.

drone.name: Drones
drone.reason: No drones are in the game; drone zones are world-plan lore only.
